item.title: Hot Chips 2026: Applying High Bandwidth Flash (HBF)
item.description:
📝 Flash memory is cheaper per gigabyte of capacity than DRAM. If a workload becomes bandwidth bound, it’s bad for HBF’s cost equation because both cost per capacity and cost per bandwidth factor into final cost. That’s more like working with a block storage device than working with memory.
🔗 Read more: https://chipsandcheese.com/p/hot-chips-2026-applying-high-bandwidth

item.title: Why older tech is sometimes safer from hackers
item.description:
📝 Although Eudora was far from perfectly secure, as people switched to newer email tools, Hyppönen realised that hackers were forgetting about Eudora. Hyppönen calls it "security by antiquity". As technology has advanced, experts have often questioned whether the latest systems are actually more risky than older ones.
🔗 Read more: https://www.bbc.com/future/article/20260821-why-older-tech-is-sometimes-safer-from-hackers
